sentences.text: As per original memorandum under Section 30-31 of the Act, IP No.3 has been described as Sh. Bhim Singh wagerah and IP No.4 has been described as Sunheri wagerah.
Vide order dated 15.04.2025, it was directed to Union of India to clarify regarding the persons falling in the category of 'wagerah'.

On 30.04.2025, one Sh. Yogesh Kumar, Patwari from LAC, South East alongwith Sh. Satish Sharma, Ld.
counsel for the Union of India was present and he submitted that name of IP No.4/Sunheri was inadvertently mentioned in the memorandum under Section 30-31 of the LA Act as the khasra numbers in question as per original memorandum under Section 30-31 LA Act did not belong to Sunheri 'wagerah' and any claim regardingq this khasra number in the present case pertains to IP No. 1, 2 and 3 and subsequently to their LRs.
He sought some time for filing written reply to the LAC concerned regarding the same.

He also submitted that he had checked the revenue record and as per revenue record, persons falling in the category of 'wagerah' as mentioned after name of IP no.3 Bhim Singh in reference memorandum includes Balbir, Kishan Lal and Vedwati.
That day, it was also clarified by Ld. counsel for IP No.3 that Sh. Kishan Lal (since deceased) expired while leaving behind two class-I legal heirs i.e. Sh. Mehar Chand and Jaina Ram.
